data.narrative:
Terranova operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Seed stage, having raised $7M to date. The comparable universe includes one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, though the narrow Seed-stage cohort lacks sufficient depth for robust peer median analysis. Top private comparables include Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable framework here. Using total raised of $7M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier for progression from Seed to the next stage yields $17.5M. This reflects the pattern observed across early-stage capital deployment in the sector, where post-Seed rounds typically reflect material increases in valuation to account for milestones achieved and risk reduction between funding events.

The Peer-Median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient data points meeting narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers). While the broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes eight private companies, filtering to same-stage and comparable-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide median analysis potentially misleading.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a median of $18M. Material uncertainties remain regarding product-market fit validation, manufacturing scale trajectory, and competitive positioning relative to the identified peer set—factors that will likely drive valuation at any subsequent funding round.
